verdict.rationale: iTerm2's own scripting delivers the core of this story. First-party docs say its AppleScript support lets you write stand-alone scripts that launch the app and open multiple sessions with profiles in new tabs or windows. An AutoLaunch.scpt runs on startup, and a Python API offers full automation. tmux -CC attach also reopens windows in their prior state. missing for 10: documentation that scripts can build split-pane layouts (pane splitting is only shown as a manual feature), any declarative config-file layout or saved-workspace feature, and independent hands-on corroboration of a one-command project workspace launch.
